tools.name: swarm_sync
tools.description: Bootstrap once; resume with an event cursor for targeted deltas.

tools.name: swarm_find
tools.description: Find scoped peers or task summaries; use taskId for details.

tools.name: swarm_assign
tools.description: Create durable work asynchronously. Reuse commandId on retry; wait separately with the returned task ID.

tools.name: swarm_task
tools.description: Claim, renew, report progress, finish, cancel or recover work. Finish requires evidence and limitations.

tools.name: swarm_send
tools.description: Send a question, blocker, decision request or completion notice. Work assignment uses swarm_assign.

tools.name: swarm_inbox
tools.description: Fetch leases one message. Ack only after processing; reject with a reason for retry.

tools.name: swarm_wait
tools.description: Wait for a task's terminal state. Timeout returns the same resumable reference without cancelling work.

tools.name: swarm_context
tools.description: Versioned shared state: get, set with expectedVersion, atomic append, or delete. Keep values small; link artifacts.

tools.name: swarm_evidence
tools.description: Capture a completed worktree file or record a result, decision or annotation with provenance. Read bytes through the returned artifact URI.
